environment.description: AWS Lambda (Quarkus native) deployed in account 998877665544, eu-west-1. Lambda execution role arn:aws:iam::998877665544:role/DiagnosticLambdaRole has AmazonS3FullAccess and AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole managed policies. The role has an IAM permission boundary attached: arn:aws:iam::998877665544:policy/LambdaNetworkDenyBoundary. This boundary policy contains an explicit Deny on ec2:CreateNetworkInterface, ec2:DescribeNetworkInterfaces, and lambda:InvokeFunction for cross-account calls. Additionally, the OU-level SCP (id: p-a1b2c3d4) attached to the organizational unit containing this account includes a condition-keyed statement that denies sts:AssumeRole when aws:PrincipalTag/service-class is not 'privileged', and denies s3:PutObject when the bucket resource ARN does not match the specific diagnostic bucket pattern. The Lambda is deployed in a private subnet with no NAT gateway and no internet gateway route, using only a VPC endpoint for S3 (gateway type, policy-restricted to the diagnostic bucket). DNS resolution for external hosts will fail. The /tmp filesystem is mounted noexec via a custom Lambda extension layer that remounts /tmp with noexec,nosuid flags at INIT phase before handler invocation.

config.scp: p-a1b2c3d4 (OU-level, denies sts:AssumeRole without privileged tag, restricts s3:PutObject to diagnostic bucket)
config.api_gateway_auth: IAM_AUTH with resource policy restricting to internal VPC endpoint
config.network: no internet egress, no NAT, private subnet only
